3554-4377-7164.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Solve the Equation by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Solve the Equation and Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

529-1251-4186-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

728-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-5003-8123.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Royal Warden, adding {C}{C}.
When Royal Warden dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Royal Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Royal Warden enters, it triggers, creating two tapped artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5671-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-5671-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3240-3899-5631-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4551-6734-8089.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

330-5429-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander which is red in color.
330-5429-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Embermaw Hellion.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

553-1927-7467.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Vedalken Orrery.
In response, cast Sudden Setback by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

3532-5078-7736-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3587-6777-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3587-6777-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Unbreakable Formation.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3587-6777-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

997-3240-5632-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

765-1558-2557-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2557-3875-4231.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2438-4976-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-4976-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

874-4195-4574-6766.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4195-4574-6766.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1430-2760-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mirror Image.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mirror Image by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4593-6719.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4593-6719.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

338-3330-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3330-4186.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

360-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

500-2081-2493.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Archaeomancer and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Archaeomancer tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-6478--111.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

3017-4772-5742-5743.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3680-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Stunt Double has a power of at least 2.
2713-3680-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Stunt Double and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Stunt Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Stunt Double to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Stunt Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Stunt Double by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1461-4050-4078-5708.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Vein Ripper trigger twice, causing you to gain 4 life and an opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4770-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Whitemane Lion
4770-5674-5870.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2919-4268-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-4268-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2292-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

3967-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
3967-5011-5326.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

3362-4783-5147.description:
Cast Hellkite Courser by paying {4}{R}{R}.
When Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hellkite Courser, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger, putting Bladewing the Risen from the command zone onto the battlefield.
When Bladewing the Risen enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing the Risen.
Choose to return Bladewing the Risen to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing the Risen trigger from step 5, returning Hellkite Courser from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

560-1645-1765-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Soldier and Squirrel, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-2034-2972-5130.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
Genesis Chamber is untapped.
678-2034-2972-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite trigger, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

147-359.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Acrobatic Maneuver.
147-359.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Acrobatic Maneuver, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Acrobatic Maneuver, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

650-3175-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.
